user.title: Rotel amplifier
user.description: Set **POWER OPTION = Quick** on the amplifier so it stays reachable over the network in standby.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the amplifier. Give it a fixed address (DHCP reservation) in your router.
data_description.port: TCP control port. Rotel uses 9590; change only if you know why.
data_description.name: Device name in Home Assistant, e.g. Living room amplifier.

sources.title: Inputs and general settings
sources.description: Next you will set up each selected input.

data_description.sources: Only these inputs appear in the source list. Unused inputs are hidden; if one is selected on the front panel it is shown with its default name.

data_description.max_volume: Amplifier level (1–96) that equals 100 % in Home Assistant. The slider covers 0…this value, and anything set above it on the remote or front panel is pulled back to it.

data_description.auto_off: Turn the amplifier off after it has been on with nothing playing for this many minutes. 0 = never. Playing means: the linked player of the current input is playing, or a digital input carries a signal. Analog inputs without a player never count as playing, so mark them "Never auto power off".

data_description.poll_interval: The amplifier reports changes by itself; polling only catches missed updates and the signal on digital inputs. Default 30 s. 0 = off.

input.title: Input {label}
input.description: Settings of the **{input}** input. Pick a linked media player and press Submit to see its options.

data_description.name: Shown in the source list instead of "{input}", e.g. Streamer, TV.
data_description.player: The media player connected to this input (streamer, smart speaker, Chromecast…). While this input is selected the amplifier entity shows its track, artwork and state, and play / pause / next / seek / browse go to it. Power, volume and input stay on the amplifier. Leave empty if nothing controllable is connected.

data.follow: Switch to this input when the player starts playing

data_description.follow: When the player starts playing, the amplifier turns on if needed, selects this input and pauses the other linked players. With this option on any input, only the current input's player may play. A second player starting within 5 s of an automatic switch is paused instead (no ping-pong).
data_description.fixed_volume: Volume is controlled on the amplifier, so the player should always output full level. Its volume is set to 100 % and unmuted at start-up and whenever someone changes it.

data.keep_on: Never auto power off on this input

data_description.ref_volume: Amplifier level at which this input sounds as loud as your other inputs, e.g. Streamer 40, Yandex station 20. When switching between two inputs that both have a value, the volume is scaled by their ratio (Streamer at 30 → station at 15). 0 = don't adjust.
data_description.keep_on: Auto power off never triggers while this input is selected. Use it for turntables, CD players and other analog sources the integration cannot see playing.

announce.title: Announcements (TTS)
announce.description: Text-to-speech and Assist can speak through the amplifier. It switches to the chosen input, the linked player speaks, then the previous input, volume and power state are restored.

data_description.announce_source: Only inputs with a linked player can be chosen. — = announcements are not supported.
data_description.announce_volume: In % of the volume scale (100 % = maximum volume). 0 = keep the current volume.

reconfigure.title: Change amplifier address
reconfigure.description: New IP address or port. Inputs, links and entity IDs are kept.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the amplifier. Give it a fixed address (DHCP reservation) in your router.
data_description.port: TCP control port. Rotel uses 9590; change only if you know why.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the amplifier. Check the address and that POWER OPTION is set to Quick.
error.no_response: The device is reachable but does not answer Rotel commands.
error.duplicate_name: Another input already has this name
error.self_player: Cannot link the amplifier to itself
